name: threshold two leaves a lone source unable to spread
input: one infected cell followed by two healthy cells
test:
original = [[1, 0, 0]]
assert simulate_recovery(original, infectious_days=1, infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[2, 0, 0]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 0]]

name: threshold two infects a cell that receives the full timer
input: two sources around one healthy cell and a two-day immune barrier
test:
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 0, 1]], infectious_days=1, infection_threshold=2) == (2, [[2, 2, 2]])
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 2, 0]], infectious_days=2, infection_threshold=2) == (2, [[2, 2, 0]])
